bio: This place describes itself as small, refined, modern, which goes both for the five tasteful guestrooms and the restaurant on the 2nd floor, where a smart modern interior meets with a distinct sense of intimacy. Guests soak up the cosy atmosphere with a personal touch, while in the open kitchen a seven-course set menu is prepared by a team headed up by owners Lukas Kapeller and Michael Schlöglhofer. Dishes such as king oyster mushrooms with celery, tarragon and nut butter or grilled pikeperch with peas, radishes and horseradish steer clear of unnecessary frills and put the focus on regional ingredients. In such a beautiful location on a small hill surrounded by greenery, it is hard to believe you're in the centre of Steyr....
